covered: v1 src/adapters/copilot-cli, copilot-base.ts, hooks/copilot-cli, configs/copilot-cli, hooks/core/tool-naming.mjs

findings.claim: v1 tells Copilot CLI users to install the plugin from a subdir of main (copilot plugin install mksglu/context-mode:configs/copilot-cli). main is frozen on v1, so copilot plugin update keeps those users on v1 forever, and the release branch has no configs/copilot-cli path. ADR-0011 only says 'test first'.
findings.evidence: cm-main configs/copilot-cli/README.md:7 'copilot plugin install mksglu/context-mode:configs/copilot-cli'; ADR-0011:45 'Copilot CLI, VS Code, Kiro, ZCode | test first, then document'; ADR-0011:11 main frozen; ADR-0010:42 lists Copilot CLI as host-managed with no command.
findings.fix: Name the v2 Copilot CLI install source (repo:path@release or a marketplace) and the exact command for v1 plugin users to move (uninstall old plugin, install new). Add a doctor D4 check that flags the v1 plugin.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 8f414d34/ebd1b4ab/5a207235 2026-06-06 'docs(copilot-cli): document the plugin bundle as the recommended install' (#787). ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'One-command install ... with no context-mode upgrade call required'. REGRESSION_RISK: v1 plugin users never see v2. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep a one-command install.

findings.claim: The v1 footprint row misses the v1 Copilot CLI plugin install (plugin-bundle hooks.json, .mcp.json, skills/context-mode) and hardcodes ~/.copilot although v1 honours COPILOT_HOME. detectV1 will miss both.
findings.evidence: cm-main src/adapters/copilot-cli/index.ts:63-72 copilotCliHome() uses COPILOT_HOME; :45 CONTEXT_MODE_COPILOT_PLUGIN env; configs/copilot-cli/.mcp.json sets CONTEXT_MODE_COPILOT_PLUGIN=1; ADR-0011:66 'whole file ~/.copilot/hooks/context-mode.json'.
findings.fix: Footprint: $COPILOT_HOME (default ~/.copilot)/hooks/context-mode.json, $COPILOT_HOME/mcp-config.json entry, the installed v1 plugin, data $COPILOT_HOME/context-mode/. Golden test with COPILOT_HOME set.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 51cac921 2026-06-06 'fix(adapters): cross-platform agy installer + copilot-cli COPILOT_HOME parity'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'a relocated COPILOT_HOME split hook writes ... from server reads ..., making sessions appear empty'. REGRESSION_RISK: v2 re-breaks this fix if it hardcodes ~/.copilot. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: one resolver for COPILOT_HOME used by hook, server, doctor.

findings.claim: The fact line says only v1 hooks call the global bin. The v1 Copilot CLI plugin MCP server also runs the global 'context-mode' bin, so after npm uninstall -g the MCP server itself fails to start, and no ctx_upgrade is reachable to clean up.
findings.evidence: cm-main configs/copilot-cli/.mcp.json 'command': 'context-mode'; configs/copilot-cli/README.md 'The MCP server runs the global context-mode binary'; ADR-0011:76.
findings.fix: State that the Copilot CLI v1 MCP entry breaks too; order: install v2 plugin first, run v2 ctx_upgrade cleanup, then npm uninstall -g.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 9f34c6f1 2026-06-21 (#787) 'MCP install via copilot mcp add context-mode -- context-mode'. REGRESSION_RISK: dead MCP server with no cleanup path. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: cleanup must run from v2, not v1.

findings.claim: README says Copilot CLI hooks must never throw, but no golden or contract test pins it. v1 fixed exactly this bug; v2 must keep a test that a malformed payload gives empty stdout + exit 0 (allow), while a real deny still returns permissionDecision.
findings.evidence: spike-hooks-verified.md:17 'preToolUse ... any error (fail-closed)'; cm-main hooks/copilot-cli/pretooluse.mjs:33-39 'Fail OPEN ... Copilot CLI 1.0.59 treats a failed PreToolUse hook as Denied'; grep 'fail-closed' in ADR-0008 returns nothing.
findings.fix: Add GP3 golden: Copilot CLI preToolUse with garbage stdin and with a DB open error -> exit 0, empty stdout. Keep v1 test tests/hooks/copilot-cli-hooks.test.ts case until v2 passes it.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 59d5e5eb 2026-06-07 'fix(copilot-cli): fail-open PreToolUse hook + gate debug logs (#787 review)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'A thrown PreToolUse hook ... uses to block EVERY tool - bricking the agent'. REGRESSION_RISK: blocker if v2 lets the hook throw. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: veto is a stdout write, never a throw.

findings.claim: build/manifests.ts generates every host manifest from table.ts, but no doc records that the Copilot CLI plugin .mcp.json needs an explicit args: [] or older Copilot CLI rejects the plugin before MCP starts.
findings.evidence: cm-main configs/copilot-cli/.mcp.json 'args': []; PRD-v2.md:256 'Manifests ... all come from adapters/table.ts'; grep 'args' in ADR-0010/0011/TECH-SPEC finds no such rule.
findings.fix: Add the constraint to the Copilot CLI row of table.ts spec and a manifest golden test asserting args: [] exists.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 94ac918f 2026-06-10 'Keep Copilot CLI plugin MCP config loadable on older CLI'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'Directive: Keep args: [] in the Copilot plugin .mcp.json unless Copilot documents it as optional'. REGRESSION_RISK: plugin fails to load on Copilot CLI 1.0.44. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: generator must emit args: [] for no-arg servers.

findings.claim: 15.3 lists camelCase Copilot names, but the evidence conflicts: the spike says PascalCase also works, v1 says PascalCase is silently ignored. No golden test pins the generated keys, and userPromptSubmitted/agentStop are name changes, not casing.
findings.evidence: spike-hooks-verified.md:17 'sessionStart/SessionStart ... VERIFIED'; cm-main configs/copilot-cli/README.md 'PascalCase keys are silently ignored and never fire'; src/adapters/copilot-cli/hooks.ts:5-9 says the opposite.
findings.fix: Pin camelCase keys plus version:1 in a manifest golden test; note the PascalCase payload shape (snake_case) is different from camelCase (camelCase fields), so the decoder must match the key used.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 778c3dd9 2026-06-08 'fix(copilot-cli): use camelCase hook event names so hooks actually fire'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'PreToolUse routing enforcement and PostToolUse capture never fired on Copilot CLI'. REGRESSION_RISK: silent no-op hooks. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep camelCase.

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC marks Copilot CLI MCP tool names [U] and does not cite v1, which maps copilot-cli to context-mode_<tool>. v1 deny hints were built on that name; S-NAMES should test it, not start from zero.
findings.evidence: cm-main hooks/core/tool-naming.mjs:28 '"copilot-cli": (tool) => `context-mode_${tool}`'; TECH-SPEC.md:193 'Copilot CLI, Kiro, ZCode | [U]'.
findings.fix: Record v1 value as the candidate with source (tool-naming.mjs:28, e6045710) and keep [U] until S-NAMES confirms it live; the PostToolUse ctx_* credit and #1028 hint depend on it.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY e6045710 2026-06-05 'feat(adapters): add Antigravity CLI (agy) + GitHub Copilot CLI support'. REGRESSION_RISK: wrong name breaks hints and credit. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: one name map in table.ts.

findings.claim: Queries use WHERE session_id = :current, but no doc names the one Copilot CLI session-id field. v1 used a 5-step fallback chain ending in pid-<ppid>, which the owner forbids (no fallback chains).
findings.evidence: cm-main src/adapters/copilot-cli/index.ts:93-111 transcript_path -> conversation_id -> session_id -> sessionId -> 'pid-${process.ppid}'; spike-hooks-verified.md:35 'camelCase names -> sessionId'.
findings.fix: Table row: Copilot CLI session id = sessionId (camelCase events). Missing id = empty id (no injection), never pid.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 9f34c6f1 2026-06-21 (#787). ORIGINAL_INTENT comment: 'sessionId (camelCase) is kept only as a defensive fallback'. That comment is now wrong for camelCase keys after 778c3dd9. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: one field per event key casing.

findings.claim: D3 compares 'host config for this agent' but does not say which file for Copilot CLI. For a plugin install the hooks live in the plugin bundle, not $COPILOT_HOME/hooks; v1 had to fix a false doctor failure for this.
findings.evidence: cm-main src/adapters/copilot-cli/index.ts:167-175 validateHooks switches to copilotPluginHooksPath when CONTEXT_MODE_COPILOT_PLUGIN=1.
findings.fix: D3 reads the source by install mode from table.ts (plugin bundle vs user hooks file).
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY e8774909 2026-06-18 'fix(copilot-cli): validate plugin runtime hooks'. REGRESSION_RISK: doctor reports missing hooks on every plugin install. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no fallback, mode comes from the table.

findings.claim: Case B rewrite on Copilot CLI assumes a Bash tool. Copilot CLI shell tool names (bash vs powershell on Windows) are not verified, and the rewrite to 'node run.mjs <base64>' is not checked for powershell.
findings.evidence: spike-hooks-verified.md:35 lists 'bash, powershell' as hook fields; TECH-SPEC.md:193 Copilot CLI names [U]; ADR-0016:26 rewrite text.
findings.fix: Add Copilot CLI shell tool names to S-NAMES and one golden per shell.
findings.archaeology: No v1 behaviour; new v2 design.
